description: Record a payment the merchant received outside cmssy - a transfer, cash, an instalment - against an order's balance; nothing is charged or verified with a provider. amountPaid rises, balanceDue falls, and the order becomes paid once the balance reaches zero. Idempotent by reference. Refused for a canceled order, one not awaiting payment, or an amount above balanceDue. For one payment covering the whole total, mark_order_paid. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the order's currency (cents), at most the order's balanceDue

reference.description: Payment reference / receipt id; a reference already recorded on the order makes the call a no-op

name: record_order_payment
title: Record order payment
